items.title: Houthi attacks disrupt Saudi energy facilities, wound 73
items.title_zh: 胡塞袭击沙特南部能源设施：73人受伤，部分作业暂停
items.summary_zh: 9月8日，伊朗支持的也门胡塞武装以导弹与无人机打击沙特南部阿卜哈、海米斯穆谢特、吉赞与奈季兰等地，沙特称73人受伤（含妇孺），能源部称多处能源设施起火并暂时停运。沙特主导联军誓言强硬回应；攻击正值美伊紧张与霍尔木兹通航受阻，布伦特油价跳升。外界担忧红海—曼德海峡作为沙特绕行出口通道同步承压。

quotes.author: Saudi Energy Ministry / Reuters
quotes.en: Operations at some energy facilities in Saudi Arabia, the world's top oil exporter, were halted on Tuesday following attacks by Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis that wounded 73 people.
quotes.zh: 作为全球最大石油出口国，沙特部分能源设施作业于周二在伊朗支持的也门胡塞武装袭击后暂停，袭击造成73人受伤。

items.fetch_notes: NM首页HTTP 429/Vercel Checkpoint；据Reuters/Guardian/NPR公开报道估分6.5

items.title: Navier-Stokes – Tristan Buckmaster [pdf]
items.title_zh: 纳维–斯托克斯之争：巴克马斯特声明与被催熟的千禧年路径
items.summary_zh: 纽约大学 Tristan Buckmaster 与 Levent Alpöge 公开三项带光滑强迫的有限时间爆破结果，并称低耗散 Navier–Stokes 进展仍待 Lean 完成。声明质疑 OpenAI 在传闻后抢跑；HN 约 1170 赞，焦点在优先权、训练数据边界与“公开方向即被AI扫平”。

quotes.author: n2d4
quotes.en: Drama/accusation summary: - Aug 15th: Tristan Buckmaster & Levent Alpöge make progress on a few important math problems, "finite-time blowup with smooth forcing for incompressible porous media, for Boussinesq, and for 3d incompressible Euler." - they do NOT have a proof for the $1,000,000 Millenium Prize problem. BUT, they do claim to have a proof for a similar (non-Millenium) Navier Stokes problem that could help lead the way there - Levent works at Anthropic, but this research was indepen
quotes.zh: 剧情/指控摘要：8月15日 Buckmaster 与 Alpöge 在若干重要数学问题上取得进展——带光滑强迫的不可压多孔介质、Boussinesq 与三维不可压 Euler 有限时间爆破。他们并没有百万美元千禧年问题的证明，但声称对相近（非千禧年）Navier–Stokes 相关问题有结果，可能通向彼处。Levent 在 Anthropic 工作，但研究称属独立合作。

quotes.author: highfrequency
quotes.en: From OpenAI: > While unlikely, we cannot rule out that de-identified data derived from their usage of our products helped improve our models This is the crux of it. If Tristan's work and insights were not used to train OpenAI models, then this just looks like a case of hyper-competitive academic sniping that has been going on for decades (check out Watson and Crick!) accelerated by AI as a tool. The fact that this is ambiguous even to OpenAI leaves one huge question: did Tristan opt out of model
quotes.zh: 来自 OpenAI：虽不太可能，我们无法排除源自其产品使用的去标识数据帮助改进了模型——这才是症结。若 Tristan 的洞见未被用于训练，这更像被 AI 加速的学术抢跑；连 OpenAI 都说不清，留下疑问：他是否选择退出训练？

items.title: OpenAI says it has solved the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem
items.title_zh: OpenAI宣称破解纳维–斯托克斯千禧年难题：万级智能体与Lean证明
items.summary_zh: OpenAI公布内部系统对Navier–Stokes存在与光滑性问题的解答，称在光滑外力、能量有限条件下可从静止发展出有限时间奇点，并附Lean形式化；训练中模型号称显著强于GPT-6 Astra，客户复现量级成本约1500万美元。公司表示不申领Clay百万奖金，同时无法完全排除去标识产品数据影响。与Buckmaster/Alpöge公开的强制Euler路径几乎同日碰撞，数学界与AI治理争论同步爆发。

quotes.author: New Scientist / OpenAI
quotes.en: OpenAI claims one of its AI models has found a solution to the Navier-Stokes problem, one of the toughest and most enduring puzzles in mathematics, sitting on the list of Millennium Prize Problems.
quotes.zh: OpenAI宣称其人工智能模型之一找到了纳维–斯托克斯问题的解答——这是数学中最艰难且持久的谜题之一，位列千禧年大奖难题名单。

items.title: On the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem
items.title_zh: OpenAI公布纳维–斯托克斯千禧年问题解答：万级智能体与Lean
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 称内部系统约88小时给出解析证明、再经约17小时 Lean 形式化，主张光滑外力下可发展有限时间奇点，并称不申领奖金。与 Buckmaster/Alpöge 强制 Euler 结果几乎同日撞车，陶哲轩等警示开放科研激励被扭曲。

quotes.author: peri-cl
quotes.en: Terence Tao has some observations that seem to be directed at this, https://mathstodon.xyz/@tao/117237320796901560 > "We have now seen that even the rumor of someone working on a problem can trigger a massive amount of AI-powered effort to flatten it before the original research project has time to reach its full potential. The incentives may now be pointing in the direction of no longer sharing any promising research directions with the broader community, which would reverse
quotes.zh: 陶哲轩似有针对性评论：我们已看到，哪怕只是某人在做某题的传闻，也能触发海量 AI 算力去抢先压平，原项目还来不及充分展开。激励可能正指向不再向社区分享有希望的研究方向。

quotes.author: pavel_lishin
quotes.en: Is this the one that was allegedly based on someone else's actual work & prompts? https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49605915 https://bsky.app/profile/quantian.bsky.social/post/3muyhwbcd... https://cims.nyu.edu/~tristanb/statement.pdf
quotes.zh: 这是不是那个据称建立在别人实际工作与提示词之上的结果？参见相关 HN 帖与 Buckmaster 的 PDF 声明。

items.title: Russia hits Kyiv after pause for US envoys' visit, killing three
items.title_zh: 美特使离开后俄恢复打击基辅：至少三人死亡
items.summary_zh: 为配合特朗普特使威特科夫与库什纳访莫斯科与基辅，双方曾宣布对对方首都停火约三天；特使离开后，俄方9月8日凌晨以弹道导弹、巡航导弹与百余架无人机恢复打击基辅，市长克利奇科等称至少3死、多人受伤，多处居民楼与民用设施受损。乌克兰再度呼吁盟国补充拦截弹，凸显“谈判窗口”与战场节奏脱节。

quotes.author: Volodymyr Zelenskyy
quotes.en: The Russian attack was complex, and the Russians deliberately planned it to cause as much damage as possible to people's lives, using ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, anti-ship missiles, and Shahed drones.
quotes.zh: 俄方袭击是复合型的，他们有意计划用弹道导弹、巡航导弹、反舰导弹与Shahed无人机尽可能伤害民众生命。

items.title: LibreOffice breaks download records after declaring it has no AI features
items.title_zh: LibreOffice宣称无AI功能后“下载破纪录”？评论区求证
items.summary_zh: 有报道称 LibreOffice 强调不含 AI 后下载创新高，HN 约640赞。高票评论指周下载随基数缓升，“破纪录”叙事弱；月度统计自2019以来大体平坦，难证明反AI叙事驱动暴涨。

quotes.author: smokel
quotes.en: The number of weekly downloads has simply been increasing over time, due to growing popularity. Calling each new high "record-breaking" is a bit meaningless. Unix timestamp counter breaks record after writing this comment.
quotes.zh: 周下载量本来就随人气慢慢涨，把每个新高都叫破纪录没什么意义。写完这条，Unix 时间戳也破纪录了。

quotes.author: Aurornis
quotes.en: I found this graph of LibreOffice downloads https://stats.documentfoundation.org/downloads Switching to the monthly view, the downloads are actually mostly flat going back to 2019 I can believe that the downloads record has been broken in the same way that the stock market hits record highs all the time because the long term trend is upward. I don’t see anything to suggest that LibreOffice is seeing a sudden surge in popularity or that lack of AI features is driving a surge of dow
quotes.zh: 看 Document Foundation 下载统计，切到月视图，2019年以来其实大体持平。我可以相信它像股市那样因长期上行而破纪录，但看不出缺AI功能正在驱动突增。

items.title: Canada's retaliatory tariffs on about C$28bn of US goods take effect
items.title_zh: 加拿大对约280亿加元美国商品反制关税生效
items.summary_zh: 9月8日零时起，加拿大对近900项美国输加商品实施15%–50%反制关税，覆盖约280亿加元进口，回应特朗普政府8月加征的对等规模关税。双方自8月下旬谈判破裂后未重启正式磋商；经济学家预计加国GDP增速或被削0.2–0.5个百分点，通胀温和抬升，企业警告勿陷入无限升级。

quotes.author: Candace Laing / Canadian Chamber of Commerce
quotes.en: Businesses understand retaliation but don't want to see endless escalation... are preparing for this trade dispute to last.
quotes.zh: 企业理解报复，但不希望看到无休止升级……并正为这场贸易争端长期化做准备。

items.title: Jellyfin 12.0
items.title_zh: Jellyfin 12.0发布：开源媒体服务器继续牵制Plex
items.summary_zh: Jellyfin 12.0 发布，HN 近600赞。终身版 Plex 用户视其为软着陆与制衡；另有帖文回顾其 Open Collective 财务缓冲，强调五年积蓄尚可支撑严肃开发。

quotes.author: doctoboggan
quotes.en: As a long time plex user with a lifetime pass, I always enjoy seeing the good progress with Jellyfin as it will increasingly give me a soft landing for when Plex finally does something to make me move. At the very least it will hopefully keep some of plex’s most user hostile behavior in check. As an aside, I recently started having Claude help me with configuring my *arr stack and it has helped tremendously. I used to have to babysit and manually intervene on maybe 10% of requests, now it’s near
quotes.zh: 作为持有终身通行证的老 Plex 用户，我乐见 Jellyfin 进展——等 Plex 终于做出逼我搬走的事时，至少有软着陆；至少能牵制一部分最敌视用户的行为。我最近还用 Claude 帮配 *arr 栈，人工救火少了很多。

quotes.author: waltbosz
quotes.en: Interesting post about Jellyfin's finances (2024) https://opencollective.com/jellyfin/updates/were-good-seriou... > We have quite a budget collected over the last 5 years, and while we're really happy to see so many in the Jellyfin community contribute to us, we want to ask you to stop! No, really. We don't actually need your money. At least, not here and now. We have over $24,000 in the bank, and with average monthly expenses of only ~$600, that's over 40 months (3.3 ye
quotes.zh: 有篇关于 Jellyfin 财务（2024）的更新挺有意思：过去五年攒下可观预算，团队对此很高兴……开源基础设施能活下去，账上现金和星标一样重要。

items.title: Iran warns of new Gulf maritime exclusion zone amid 'economic warfare'
items.title_zh: 伊朗警告以“经济战”为由划设海湾海上禁区
items.summary_zh: 伊朗最高国家安全委员会秘书雷扎伊称，若美方继续“经济战”，将在波斯湾至封锁线一带设立海上禁区，进入该区过境霍尔木兹的船只或被列入伊方制裁名单，并扬言已“根本性调整”对美军舰与基地的作战姿态。霍尔木兹通航已大幅萎缩，油价逼近每桶100美元；美方拒绝承认伊对水道收费与管辖主张。

quotes.author: Mohsen Rezaei
quotes.en: Economic warfare will be met by a maritime exclusion zone across the Persian Gulf to the blockade perimeter.
quotes.zh: 经济战将换来横跨波斯湾直至封锁线的海上禁区。

items.title: There's a new "Google Jail" for independent wikis
items.title_zh: 独立维基遭遇新的“谷歌监狱”
items.summary_zh: 文章讨论独立维基被谷歌搜索困入低可见度的现象，HN 约515赞。有团队称即便不在子域，建站体验也符合文中描述；亦有人吐槽 Fandom 广告墙，凸显发现渠道被平台垄断的脆弱。

quotes.author: JayNeely
quotes.en: The article says this isn't an issue for subdomains of established domains, but the issues it describes match what we experienced setting up a game wiki for Cyber Knights: Flashpoint at https://cyberknightswiki.tresebrothers.com/ -- almost a year of not having any pages show up in search results, even though we were getting good links to it and there were no better alternatives that should have ranked (we never started the wiki for this game on any centralized site; at most all th
quotes.zh: 文章说这对老域名的子域不是问题，但我们给 Cyber Knights: Flashpoint 建游戏维基时遇到的状况，与文中描述高度一致。

quotes.author: raincole
quotes.en: When I still payed Dota, there was a wiki hosted on fandom. The experience was terrible. It wasn't always update-to-date with the latest patch, and on mobile there were so many ads rendering the whole thing unreadable. The catch is that there was a better wiki, called Liquipedia. But Google never showed it first and I kept getting tricked to click that shitty fandom site. (It was years ago. But I just tested it a bit and for most Dota-related keywords, fandom is still ranked higher than liquiped
quotes.zh: 我还在玩 Dota 时，Fandom 上的维基体验很糟：补丁更新不及时，手机端广告多到页面几乎难用。
